007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ProfileAttributes;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ProfileStatus;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for creating a Select AI profile through {@link SelectAI}.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
022 * {@link ProfileAttributes} payload, call
023 * {@link SelectAI#profile(String, ProfileAttributes, String, ProfileStatus)},
024 * invoke {@link Profile#create()}, and print metadata for the created
025 * profile.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>This sample changes database state by creating the profile identified by
028 * {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME}. Verify the profile name before running it.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>To run this sample with an object list that references the Oracle
031 * sample schema objects {@code SH.CUSTOMERS} and {@code SH.COUNTRIES}, ensure
032 * the {@code SH} schema is installed and visible to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}.
033 * The {@code SH} schema is not guaranteed to exist in every Oracle Autonomous
034 * AI Database or Oracle Database instance. If those objects are not available,
035 * set {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST} to objects visible to
036 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, or omit the object list and rely on the configured
037 * object-list mode.</p>
038 *
039 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
040 * <ul>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER</li>
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
050 * <ul>
051 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_DESCRIPTION - defaults to a sample description.</li>
052 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_STATUS - initial profile status, such as
053 *       {@code enabled} or {@code disabled}. Defaults to the database default.</li>
054 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_MODEL - provider model identifier.</li>
055 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT - provider endpoint host/path.
056 *       The SDK does not derive provider endpoints from provider name, region,
057 *       or Azure resource name; set this variable when the profile requires
058 *       {@code provider_endpoint}.</li>
059 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_REGION</li>
060 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST_MODE - defaults to {@code automated}.</li>
061 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST - optional object-list JSON used when
062 *       constraining profile metadata. This value is not required when
063 *       {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST_MODE} is set; when omitted, object
064 *       selection follows database behavior for the supplied mode.</li>
065 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_API_FORMAT</li>
066 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID</li>
067 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_ENDPOINT_ID</li>
068 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE</li>
069 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_COMMENTS - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
070 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_CONSTRAINTS - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
071 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_MAX_TOKENS - defaults to {@code 1024}.</li>
072 * </ul>
073 *
074 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
075 * <pre>{@code
076 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
077 * }</pre>
078 *
079 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
080 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
081 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
082 * <pre>{@code
083 * mvn clean install
084 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
085 * }</pre>
086 *
087 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
088 * <pre>{@code
089 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/selectai/CreateProfileWithSelectAISample.java
090 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai.CreateProfileWithSelectAISample
091 * }</pre>
092 *
093 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
094 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
095 * and diagnostics.</p>
096 */
097public final class CreateProfileWithSelectAISample {
098    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateProfileWithSelectAISample.class);
099
100    private CreateProfileWithSelectAISample() {
101    }
102
103    public static void main(String[] args) {
104        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
105        String description = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_DESCRIPTION",
106                "Profile created by the Java Select AI SDK sample.");
107
108        try {
109            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
110            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName, buildProfileAttributes(), description, profileStatus());
111            boolean created = profile.create();
112
113            System.out.printf("Create profile '%s' completed: %s%n",
114                    valueOrEmpty(profile.getProfileName()), created);
115            System.out.printf("Status      : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getStatus()));
116            System.out.printf("Description : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getDescription()));
117        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
118            LOGGER.error("Failed to create Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
119        }
120    }
121
122    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
123        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
124                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
125                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
126                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
127                .build();
128
129        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
130    }
131
132    private static ProfileAttributes buildProfileAttributes() {
133        ProfileAttributes.Builder builder = ProfileAttributes.builder()
134                .credentialName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_CREDENTIAL_NAME"))
135                .provider(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER"))
136                .objectListMode(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST_MODE", "automated"))
137                .comments(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_COMMENTS", "true")))
138                .constraints(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_CONSTRAINTS", "true")))
139                .maxTokens(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_MAX_TOKENS", "1024")));
140
141        applyOptionalString(builder::model, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_MODEL");
142        applyOptionalString(builder::additionalInstructions, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_ADDITIONAL_INSTRUCTIONS");
143        applyOptionalString(builder::role, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_ROLE");
144        applyOptionalString(builder::providerEndpoint, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT");
145        applyOptionalString(builder::region, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_REGION");
146        applyOptionalString(builder::objectList, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST");
147        applyOptionalString(builder::ociApiformat, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_API_FORMAT");
148        applyOptionalString(builder::ociCompartmentId, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID");
149        applyOptionalString(builder::ociEndpointId, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_ENDPOINT_ID");
150        applyOptionalString(builder::ociRuntimetype, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_OCI_RUNTIME_TYPE");
151
152        return builder.build();
153    }
154
155    private static void applyOptionalString(StringAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
156        String value = System.getenv(envName);
157        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
158            setter.set(value);
159        }
160    }
161
162    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
163        String value = System.getenv(name);
164        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
165            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
166        }
167        return value;
168    }
169
170    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
171        String value = System.getenv(name);
172        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
173    }
174
175    private static ProfileStatus profileStatus() {
176        String value = System.getenv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_STATUS");
177        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : ProfileStatus.fromValue(value);
178    }
179
180    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
181        return value == null ? "" : value;
182    }
183
184    @FunctionalInterface
185    private interface StringAttributeSetter {
186        void set(String value);
187    }
188}
